description.p: Native music client for your music servers and local music folders, with built-in Discord and Last.fm integration

ul.li: Can connect to multiple Jellyfin, Subsonic, Navidrome servers as well as multiple local folders, and can seamlessly switch between them
Built-in Last.fm, Libre.fm, and ListenBrainz scrobbling
Discord Rich Presence
Automatic lyrics/cover art lookup
Smart playlists that support multiple combinations
And other music player basics
Added required system tray permission for the flatpak
Added incremental library scans, rescans are now more efficient
Library sync now detects changes more precisely

description.p: This has been a fruitful release, got to make pages more consistent with the app UI, and fix a lot of bugs thanks to people reporting on Github. There is more optimization for caching, and QoL I'm working on, so stay tuned!

ul.li: Redesigned artist, album and playlists pages
Added an option to close the app to tray, and added multimedia controls to tray icon
Added in-app toast notifications for server auth
Playing notification now correctly shows the the album artwork
Queue is now kept alive, it no longer refreshes and jumps to first entry on clicking one item
Fixed an issue sidebar icons were not showing up in flatpak
Initial caching screen now reports progress
Fixed a bug where items got buried under the right sidebar, or pushed the right sidebar out of the window
Fixed a bug that automatic lyrics fetching could fetch lyrics just based on song names
Fixed a bug that shuffle relied on a stagnant queue
Fixed a bug that causes app to crash during smart playlist creation
Reworked lyrics search to it work reliably for any query

description.p: This is another big release, with wide range of bug fixes and performance improvements, specifically for local folders. I'm thankful to all the people who submitted issues. We now have smart playlists. You can combine different rules as well. Currently this is WIP, there can be more work to do on this. You can change the regular seekbar with waveform one. Waveforms are calculated lazily based on the queue to not throttle the performance. Implemented a wider range of Auto DJ features.
This is a big release, workflows of the repository are hardened and automatized further.

ul.li: Fixed a bug where home page refreshes needlessly.
Made server connection more robust, added timeouts/size limits to prevent unnecassary hangs
Refactored secret storage keys, scrobbling keys are also in secret storage now.

description.p: -Added support for translations - Created CONTRIBUTING.md - Fixed Jellyfin timeout issue for native builds
Fix Flathub app icon sizing.
Restore Native music client summary.
Restore Discord Rich Presence reliability and MPRIS artwork updates
This is Rufin's initial Flathub release. Discord Rich Presence now requests access only to the IPC socket instead of the full Discord folder.
Fixed version detection in packaged builds.
Fixed Flatpak keyring reconnect handling so saved credentials reconnect more reliably.
Added a fullscreen player. Restored album artwork, row context menus, artist cover fallbacks, and portal-backed secrets for Flatpak builds.
Reduced cover art cache memory growth. Large libraries should use less memory during navigation.
Improved library loading and scrolling responsiveness. Artwork lookup now blocks first-run navigation less and retries external cover misses after Last.fm changes.
Moved cache data to XDG cache locations and separated app cache paths. Fixed local library setup, cover caching, window geometry persistence, and duplicate local genre covers.
Refined playback controls, media context menus, playlist views, and library navigation. Improved route scrolling, sidebar alignment, cover alignment, and playback defaults.

Added unified source selection for servers and local folders, path mapping for local playback, and draggable customization for sidebar and home sections. Improved first-run login, home refreshes, and source settings.
Added scrobbling account connection flows and a daily update prompt. Improved metadata and artwork lookup, local playback matching, adaptive layout stability, lyrics handling, and sidebar behavior.
Added built-in scrobbling for external services. Refined album details, restored window sizing, and updated packaging metadata.
Added local playback support and improved playback behavior. Library pages now append more rows during browsing, and local folder management is easier to use.
Added Subsonic streaming support, Jellyfin server discovery, Discord Rich Presence, and configurable library layouts. Improved search, lyrics lookup, and Flatpak packaging.
Added cached Jellyfin home sections and improved right-panel queue search. Refined route headers, compact layouts, table links, and lyrics behavior.
Improved album card sizing, player controls, queue behavior, lyrics scrolling, and responsive navigation.
Initial preview with a native GTK shell, Jellyfin login, cached library browsing, and GStreamer playback.
